sentences.text: Good morning! I kept watch all night, and I noticed that the temperature stayed below 18.0 °C in the living room, which was at its coldest at 05:40 at 16.9 °C.
The bathroom was also cool, reaching 17.3 °C at 05:20, and the parents' room was at 17.5 °C at 01:50.
Since all three rooms stayed below 18.0 °C, and the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons, maybe it is time to check the heating.
